source_title: WonderBotz Relaunches its Agentic Process Management Playbook with Two Key Partners - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Updated executive playbook adds the data layer AI agents depend on; Anthropic and Tungsten Automation join the WonderBotz partner ecosystem
PRINCETON, N.J. , Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- WonderBotz today announced the relaunch of its Agentic Process Management (APM) playbook, the executive framework for how enterprise leaders plan, govern, and scale AI agents, people, and robots as one operation. The third edition makes explicit the data foundations discipline WonderBotz has operationalized with clients over the past year, and is available now.
Data foundations have underpinned APM practice from the start. Orchestration and governance only hold if the data underneath them can be trusted, and an agent's output is exactly as reliable as the foundation it draws from. A year of running agentic operations at client scale showed that the data layer deserves the same explicit treatment as the disciplines it supports. The relaunched playbook names it as a first-class layer: the data foundation beneath orchestration, fidelity, and stewardship, the one that makes the other three enforceable.
"Every new technology arrives with the same temptation: monetize it first and build the operating model later. That order is backwards," said Steve LaValle, Co-Founder and Co-CEO of WonderBotz. "Data foundations have always been load-bearing in APM. You cannot govern an agent whose data you don't trust, and every agent you deploy pays interest on your data debt. A year of operating at client scale convinced us they should be explicit, not assumed. We put the floor on the blueprint."
The playbook is available at wonderbotz.com/lp/apm . It anchors a relaunched wonderbotz.com , redesigned to put APM and the AlwayzOn operating platform at the center of how WonderBotz presents its work.
Alongside the relaunch, WonderBotz added Anthropic and Tungsten Automation to its partner ecosystem, joining UiPath, SS&C Blue Prism, ABBYY, Druid AI, and Microsoft Power Platform. Anthropic's Claude now powers a growing set of prebuilt WonderBotz solutions, starting in finance and accounting and extending into new functions such as AI-powered marketing agents.
"We apply one test to every new capability: build or borrow, whichever gets a client to scale faster," said Bhavyesh Virani, Co-Founder and Co-CEO of WonderBotz. "Anthropic and Tungsten Automation let us borrow world-class engines, so our build capacity goes where clients actually need it: the last mile between a model and a governed business outcome."
The relaunch builds on WonderBotz's early recognition by Gartner. In its March 2024 report, "GMs: Harness the Power of Process, AI and Data Orchestrators via Platform Software," Gartner named WonderBotz a Provider Example of Specialist digital workforce coordinators. APM is the WonderBotz executive playbook for institutionalizing AI: the operating discipline covering orchestration, fidelity, stewardship, and the data foundation that leaders need to move beyond one-off automations to AI capabilities that scale safely across the enterprise.
WonderBotz is an agentic operating company and the team behind Agentic Process Management (APM), the operating discipline for orchestrating AI, automation, and people into measurable business outcomes. Founded in 2017 by former Big Four leaders, WonderBotz helps enterprises launch, modernize, and manage intelligent operations without forcing a complete technology replacement. Its AlwayzOn managed services keep a client's Agents, AI, and Botz governed, orchestrated, and always on. WonderBotz serves mid-market to Fortune 100 clients across banking, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and retail, with delivery operations in the U.S. and India.
